event.summary: Deleted cleanup regression test has no equivalent unmarked-shell premise
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 70bc66a9f285cc2a9984924f389834d118b7cfdc. TLDR: removing this test loses the check that Delete reaches background work when the terminal shell's own environment cannot be read, the macOS failure the deleted test was written to prevent. Suggested bucket: other (test coverage regression; no shipped malfunction established). Confidence: confirmed by source, not execution. Details: the removed delete_reaps_an_unmarked_process_under_a_tab_shell test (parent core.rs:21490-21690; deletion at reviewed core.rs:21621) execs env -i in the tab's own pane process, verifies that both shell and job have no session marker, disables scopes and asserts both are gone after Delete. The commit message says the host e2e test covers the same behavior, but host_tabs.rs:1374-1452, close_stop_and_delete_kill_a_hangup_immune_unmarked_job_of_a_tab, clears only the background job's environment at :1393; its tab shell keeps FARHELM_TAB_ID and the session marker (it reads FARHELM_TAB_ID at :1392 and then execs /bin/sh -i). service/sweep.rs:550-561 explicitly says marker processes are roots expanded through their descendants, and :597-618 admits marked processes before expanding the PPID closure. Thus the purported replacement can pass without the explicit tab-child root: its marked shell already makes the unmarked job reachable. The deleted test excludes that competing mechanism. service/teardown.rs:181-206 describes why every tab pane must itself be a root when macOS hides a platform shell's environment. Preserve an equivalent shell-unmarked fixture on terminal hosts, or keep the old regression until that replacement exists. Could-be-highest: no; established impact is a test gap, confined to maintainer tooling; the possible future process leak is not an established shipped regression. proposed_drop: false. possible_cover: none known; forbidden coverage sources not searched. Caveats: this does not allege current Delete leaks jobs; the explicit roots remain in production. The review judges this intermediate revision, even if later commits remove the tmux path.

event.summary: Existing Delete-root regression narrows the claimed lost cleanup coverage
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 70bc66a9f285cc2a9984924f389834d118b7cfdc; synthesis checked through pinned tip 00de0b6c9cf206f1a7c9c5ad1c76b5b10eaf85db. That specific end-to-end premise is still lost. However the earlier finding overstated the missing assurance: a pre-existing independent regression does exercise explicit unmarked tab-child roots through Delete. Source evidence: original host_terminals.rs:2264-2313 and tip :2240-2289, delete_roots_children_after_failed_agent_and_tab_reconnects, run both agent and tab cases; the test pins a real child, makes recovery fail, verifies the child is still running, calls Delete, and asserts !runs(child) before fixture cleanup. Host shutdown deliberately fails because the peer is the test runner, so successful host teardown cannot account for that observation. Tip hosts/terminal/test_host.rs:424-450 starts the real sleep child directly with no s1 session/tab markers added, rather than under a marked shell; core/tests/host_terminals.rs:2629-2691 ties it only through the adopted tab runtime and removes the tab launch record before Delete. session_hosts.rs:510-528 roots both ordinary and recovered-placeholder tabs through the same pinned_child_root loop. Separately sweep.rs:2159-2190 tests root-child-grandchild PPID expansion without any marker inputs. This provides layered regression coverage for the host path, although not the removed exact shell-plus-job fixture. Production explicit roots remain in teardown.rs:318-370 and session_hosts.rs:510-548; that alone would NOT refute a missing-test defect, and is not the basis for this proposed drop. It has a different trigger and oracle; the host pinned-root evidence here does not refute that separate test gap. event.summary: Unmarked tab-shell cleanup loses its integrated regression oracle
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 70bc66a9f285cc2a9984924f389834d118b7cfdc; checked through pinned tip 00de0b6c9cf206f1a7c9c5ad1c76b5b10eaf85db. TLDR: deleting the regression removes the integrated check that Delete kills a tab shell and its background job when neither carries a readable session marker and no system scope can clean them up. This narrows the original missing-assurance claim; no shipped cleanup malfunction is established. Details: deleted parent core.rs:21490-21690 execs env -i in the tab's own pane, asserts shell and job both lack session markers, confirms both are live and HUP-resistant with no usable scope, then requires both gone after successful Delete. At this intermediate revision old tmux tabs are still supported; SPEC_impl.md:2970-3005 describes retained old-terminal operation and service/teardown.rs:181-210 requires other_pane_roots precisely because macOS can hide the tab shell's environment. Its marker-root alternative remains concrete in sweep.rs:550-625: marked processes become PPID-closure roots before expansion. The commit-cited replacement host_tabs.rs:1374-1452 (tip :972-1043) scrubs only a background job and leaves the shell marked, so it cannot distinguish explicit tab-child rooting from marker-root expansion. Existing host_terminals.rs:2264-2313 (tip :2240-2289), delete_roots_children_after_failed_agent_and_tab_reconnects, does meaningfully assert Delete kills an unmarked real stand-in child through a recovered placeholder runtime, before cleanup and despite later host-end refusal. Its child is a directly spawned sleep, not the removed shell/job composition, and its root collection is the host path in session_hosts.rs:510-548. sweep.rs:2159-2190 separately checks transitive closure over synthetic process identities. These layered tests narrow the gap but neither exercises the old tmux other_pane_roots caller nor establishes the combined unmarked-shell/HUP-immune-job/scopes-off/successful-Delete oracle. They therefore do not refute that specific lost regression coverage. Suggested fix: retain the old fixture while the legacy branch is supported, or migrate its complete premise and both-process death assertions into an appropriate retained fixture. Suggested bucket: other, test coverage. Confidence: confirmed source/test-contract comparison, no execution. Could-be-highest: no established security or loss-of-work route; future undetected cleanup failures are hypothetical and do not elevate this test defect. proposed_drop: false for the remaining narrow integrated-oracle gap. Earlier proposed-drop basis is preserved: the independent host pinned-root test plus pure transitive-closure test refute a broad claim that explicit roots or PPID traversal have no tests; they do not replace this specific oracle. Later retirement of the tmux branch in 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333 makes that legacy branch obsolete at tip but does not erase its supported intermediate gap. No parent drop/lowering was accepted. possible_cover: g107/g107-c4 and g108/c2 concern lone legacy-tab discovery/listing, Delete guard and Stop after agent loss, a different trigger and oracle; do not merge this marker-invisibility gap into those. All neighbour records read from discovery-neighbours.json only, not prohibited coverage sources.
